pinyin: Qiānlǐ zhī xíng, shǐ yú zúxià
translation: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.

pinyin: Shú néng shēng qiǎo
translation: Practice makes perfect.

pinyin: Huó dào lǎo, xué dào lǎo
translation: Live until old, learn until old — you're never too old to learn.

pinyin: Yī fēn gēngyún, yī fēn shōuhuò
translation: One part of effort, one part of harvest — you reap what you sow.

pinyin: Bǎi wén bù rú yī jiàn
translation: Hearing about something a hundred times is not as good as seeing it once.

pinyin: Yǒu zhì zhě shì jìng chéng
translation: Where there's a will, there's a way.

pinyin: Shībài shì chénggōng zhī mǔ
translation: Failure is the mother of success.

pinyin: Dī shuǐ chuān shí
translation: Dripping water pierces stone — persistence overcomes obstacles.

pinyin: Huà shé tiān zú
translation: Drawing a snake and adding feet — to ruin something by overdoing it.

pinyin: Wáng yáng bǔ láo
translation: Mend the pen after the sheep is lost — better late than never.

pinyin: Rù xiāng suí sú
translation: When entering a village, follow its customs — when in Rome, do as the Romans do.

pinyin: Duì niú tán qín
translation: Playing the lute to a cow — wasting effort explaining to someone who won't understand.

pinyin: Sàiwēng shī mǎ, yān zhī fēi fú
translation: The old man lost his horse, but who knows if it isn't a blessing — a setback may be a blessing in disguise.

pinyin: Dú wàn juàn shū, xíng wàn lǐ lù
translation: Read ten thousand books, travel ten thousand miles.

pinyin: Bù rù hǔ xué, yān dé hǔ zǐ
translation: If you don't enter the tiger's den, how can you get its cubs — nothing ventured, nothing gained.

pinyin: Sān rén xíng, bì yǒu wǒ shī yān
translation: Among any three people walking together, one can surely be my teacher.

pinyin: Yù sù zé bù dá
translation: More haste, less speed.

pinyin: Jìn zhū zhě chì, jìn mò zhě hēi
translation: Near vermilion, one turns red; near ink, one turns black — you become like those around you.

pinyin: Shū dào yòng shí fāng hèn shǎo
translation: Only when you need to use your knowledge do you regret not having read more.

hanzi: 少壮不努力，老大徒伤悲
pinyin: Shàozhuàng bù nǔlì, lǎodà tú shāngbēi
translation: If you don't work hard while young, you'll only grieve in old age.
source: Han Yuefu poem, Long Song Ballad

pinyin: Xiào yī xiào, shí nián shào
translation: A smile makes you ten years younger.

pinyin: Zhījǐ zhībǐ, bǎizhàn bùdài
translation: Know yourself and know your enemy, and you will never be defeated.

hanzi: 工欲善其事，必先利其器
pinyin: Gōng yù shàn qí shì, bì xiān lì qí qì
translation: A craftsman who wishes to do good work must first sharpen his tools.

pinyin: Bīngdòng sān chǐ, fēi yī rì zhī hán
translation: Three feet of ice does not form in a single day — big problems build up over time.
